findings.what: There is not one Android pixel anywhere in this capture: both platform artifacts are absent for the second capture running (DIFF: "not captured in this session or the last"), MANIFEST.json `browser` is "webkit" and frames.json `source` is "webkit" for all five clips, and the reason offered for the two stills, "not captured this session", restates the absence rather than giving a cause (frames.json is franker about the third gap: "no Android device was up in this session").
findings.why: The row requires that both platforms serve the same regions, the same feelings and the same event types; with every artifact drawn by one engine and the one artifact designed to put two devices side by side missing twice over, that clause has no artifact evidence at all.

findings.why: The claim being scored is that the artifacts show one system rather than an assembly, and a capture that re-shoots a single frame cannot re-establish it - though the reports do mitigate this, since 01-05, 12 and 14 all carry seed 20260903 and events 14062 and so are one consistent state of one log.

what_is_working: One log and no second store is visible anywhere in the evidence: every region report taken in the same pass (01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 12, 14) carries the same seed 20260903 and the same events count 14062, with a single sync cursor that both ends agree on; reliability.json shows events_host 174, events_client 174, duplicates 0, same_order_both_sides true, ordering monotonic after five injected faults; coldstart.json shows the same four ULIDs in the same order in spine_host_order and spine_client_order.

The same event is identifiably the same event in three regions: ULID 0001M4GW48FEW3M67XKAZT5051 (feeling empty_chair, from teo, ts 1788455973000 = 2026-09-03 17:19) appears in 01_pulse.report recent_feelings, in 12_search.report visible and in 13_messenger_states.report visible, and it is drawn as the same chair-in-ink object labelled "empty chair 17:19" on the Pulse shelf of 01_pulse.png and as "empty chair - Thu 3 Sep - 17:19" in the Chat stream of 13_messenger_states.png. All six Pulse shelf labels (17:19, 16:58, 16:23, 11:54, 06:42, 21:58) match their report timestamps to the minute.

Modules write into the same log and surface in other regions' views: 02_chat.png carries a ritual_kept row ("text when home | KEPT") inside the ordinary message stream with the ordinary paper and the ordinary read ticks, and 13_messenger_states.png likewise carries a feeling and a state_declared row among five messages.

A fifth shared-life module is already there and costs nothing structurally: logs/03_us.report.json lists five modules with per-module event counts - dates 81, todos 199, calendar 6, rituals 53, shelf 12 - each with its own one-line glance, and 03_us.png shows them as the same kind of card on the same desk with no seam where the newest one was joined; logs/strings.json reads strings from five sibling paths under app/lib/modules/ (calendar, dates, rituals, shelf, todos).

Partner state is legible on every region, not only Pulse: the standing strip "week one, and the room smells right again / TRAVELLING - NEED ||| - ENERGY |" sits at the top of 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 12 and 13 and of every frame of 06, 07, 08, 11 and 15; it is correctly absent from 10_first_run.png and 17_setup_pwa.png, whose reports show events 0 and link connecting.

State propagates and the propagation is visible away from Pulse: in 08_state_propagating.mp4 the standing strip reads TRAVELLING for the first four runs and OUT in the final frame while the reader is on the Us region, and logs/08_state_propagating.report.json ends with ambient.standing_line "restless - week one, and the room smells right again - out - 7 hours ago" at cursor 14082 with peer_cursor 14082.

A feeling lands wherever the reader happens to be rather than only in its home region: 07_feeling_landing.mp4 runs Pulse to Chat to Us and its report ends with sensation {feeling: soup, channel: page, total_ms 1200} while region is "us"; 15_authored_feeling.mp4 ends with the same object washing over the Settings region.

One feeling vocabulary underlies all of it: logs/haptics.check.json holds 36 feelings in six families (Warmth 6, Ache 5, Shelter 7, Mischief 7, Static 6, Sparkle 5) with 36 distinct haptic strings and no near-duplicate shapes, of which 2 are authored; the picker in 15_authored_feeling.mp4 shows exactly those six family names, and each feeling carries one object, one sound and one pattern that the notation says drives Android's VibrationEffect and the PWA page from the same segments.

verdict: On the evidence this is one system, and the proof is not decorative: every region report from the same pass carries the same seed and the same events count 14062 against a single cursor both ends agree on, reliability.json puts 174 events in the same order on both sides with no duplicates through five injected faults, and one ULID - 0001M4GW48FEW3M67XKAZT5051 - can be followed by hand from the Pulse shelf to a Chat row to a search hit, drawn the same way and stamped 17:19 in both places. Modules are plainly views rather than silos: a rituals event sits in the ordinary Chat stream on ordinary paper, Us lists five modules with their own event counts and glance lines and shows no seam where the fifth was added, and the partner's state is legible in the top strip of every region, changing to OUT on the Us screen at the end of 08 rather than only on Pulse. What holds the score down is what the evidence does not contain and what it renders empty. There is no Android pixel in this capture at all - 09_two_devices.png and 16_setup_android.png are absent for the second capture running behind a reason that only restates the absence, every clip's source is webkit, and so the clause about both platforms serving the same regions, feelings and event types is unevidenced rather than met; that alone caps this category at its floor. Beneath it sits a repeating failure of the view itself: the message-arrival clip ends on a hard-edged blank sheet held for 0.74 s with the report insisting it has a tear and a paper stock, a blank chat row is held for 2.32 s in 08 where the previous file held it for 1.20 s, four Moments cards over a thousand pixels of screen carry no picture while the report admits eight of twenty-six tiles asked for nothing, and the one video the Chat still was anchored on is clipped to a blank strip under the composer. A log that is coherent and views that intermittently render nothing is still, from the reader's side, an app with holes in it. Score 13 of 15: at the floor, held there by the missing platform and kept off the floor's edge by unusually direct evidence of the single log.
